noticias.titular: Cam Schlittler sees ERA dip to 1.95 as Yankees defeat Mets
noticias.texto: Cam Schlittler, after a dominant outing on Sunday against the Mets that dropped his ERA to 1.95, is the clear-cut favorite to take home the American League Cy Young Award, but Yankees manager Aaron Boone also thinks the starter could be the AL MVP too.

noticias.titular: Giants slugger Devers' season ends early due to core muscle injury
noticias.texto: San Francisco's Rafael Devers' season is over, and he may have surgery for a core muscle injury.

noticias.titular: Orioles put RHP Kyle Bradish on IL with abdominal discomfort
noticias.texto: Right-hander Kyle Bradish was put on the 15-day injured list by the Orioles on Sunday because of lower abdominal discomfort, effectively ending his season.

noticias.titular: Yankees' Schmidt to be activated this week and pitch out of bullpen
noticias.texto: Clarke Schmidt will be activated this week and will rejoin the New York Yankees as a reliever, 14 months after elbow surgery.

noticias.titular: Diamondbacks designate Lourdes Gurriel Jr. for assignment
noticias.texto: The Diamondbacks have designed Lourdes Gurriel Jr. for assignment, potentially ending the tenure of an outfielder who played a key role in their recent World Series run but struggled after tearing his ACL last season.
